unlisted_practices: Consent-guided routine patient engagement for multi-domain health data abstraction and cloud migration to support AI-CDS development
Routine collection of social determinants of health and patient-reported health status to contextualize and evaluate AI models for fairness

screen.reason: Describes and demonstrates feasibility in over 30,000 patients of an institutional governance framework (PULSE) incorporating consent, data abstraction, and equity/SDOH contextualization for AI-augmented care, but does not compare outcomes with/without a specific guardrail practice.
